name: Wise Plastics
old_description: 100+ presses from 35 to 1100 tons, liquid silicone molding, and value-added operations under one quality system — 30 minutes from Chicago and O'Hare.
about:
Wise Plastics Technologies, headquartered in St. Charles, Illinois, traces its roots to 1974 when it was founded as Wise‑Hamlin Plastics in the greater Chicagoland area. The company has remained independently owned and operates three purpose‑built facilities totaling more than 350,000 square feet, all within 30 minutes of Chicago and O’Hare International Airport.

The molder runs over 100 injection presses ranging from 35 to 1,100 tons, supporting custom plastic injection molding, two‑shot, insert and over‑molding, in‑mold labeling, and liquid silicone rubber (LSR) molding for medical‑grade and biocompatible applications. Value‑added operations include assembly, sonic welding, heat staking, printing, decorating, packaging and kitting. Engineering services cover design for manufacturing, rapid prototyping, mold design and build, process optimization and failure analysis. The quality lab provides first‑article inspection, capability studies, IQ/OQ/PQ, PPAP and CMM inspection, with scientific molding processes monitored 24/5 and 24/7 when demand requires.

Wise Plastics serves the medical device and pharmaceutical sectors, holding ISO 13485:2016 certification for medical‑device quality management, and is ITAR registered for defense‑related work. The company also supports a range of other industries through its supply‑chain management, inventory and logistics programs.

Founded on a vision to provide reliable, high‑quality injection molding partnerships, Wise Plastics emphasizes purpose‑built facilities, integrated manufacturing operations, advanced automation on every cell, and a team of 200‑plus skilled employees who operate around the clock. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016, and the firm holds OSHA SHARP recognition for safety.
